answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The garden multiplier is published, charged in mirror, and quartz lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 1095 identities would post 2825 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
